# Dharmik Gohil

> Unity game developer and XR/AR-VR specialist based in Surat, Gujarat, India. Final-year B.Tech IT student at CHARUSAT University (DEPSTAR College), available for hire on Unity 3D/2D games, real-time multiplayer (Photon PUN), AR/VR/XR experiences, and full-stack web development (React, Node.js, MongoDB).

Dharmik Gohil builds shipped, playable games — not just prototypes. He has 10+ published titles on itch.io, has won hackathons including IIT Bombay Techfest 2025, Hack-A-Vation, and Hackron 2025, and co-founded the Indian Developer Community (IDC), a 150+ member community for Indian game and software developers.

## Hire / Contact

- Contact page: https://dharmikgohil.art/contact.html
- Email: dharmikgohil.work@gmail.com
- Free consultation offered; typical response within 24 hours
- Available for freelance contracts, internships, and remote projects worldwide

## Services

- Unity 3D/2D game development (single-player and multiplayer)
- Real-time multiplayer games with Photon PUN (lobbies, matchmaking, player sync)
- AR/VR/XR experiences using AR Foundation, Oculus SDK, XR Toolkit
- Full-stack web development (React, Node.js, MongoDB, MySQL)
- ERPNext implementation and business process automation
- Web3 / blockchain development
- n8n workflow automation

- Simple 2D mobile games: from ₹25,000
- Multiplayer 3D games with Photon PUN: from ₹1,50,000
